title: Insane 23-Year-Old Goes Ballistic On Police For Doing Their Job
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 12th, 2023. Multiple officers were dispatched to a neighbourhood in regards to  gun shots being heard. Upon arrival a 23-year-old man approached officers and immediately became uncooperative. He got upset at the officers for showing up  and asking questions. Although there were no gun shots that were actually dispersed, the man got arrested due to his violent behaviour towards everyone around him. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
